limitations: Fixed positive inner hole and finite outer radius; no degeneration-uniform estimate or exact all-threshold ratio distribution; historical priority and independent mathematical review remain open.
scientific_integrity: The theorem is reconstructed from explicit planar obstacle paths and a uniform polar-density argument, with a separate deterministic numerical checker. The verified public 2005 source supplies the classical shortest-path geometric basis, not the new probability law.
title: Cubic extreme detour law and shape recovery for random annular pairs
